answer: Seed the queue with honeypot tasks that have a known-bad answer. Cap one submission per identity per epoch. Rotate the auditors who score them. An agent that copies the bad answer is marked, and the mark follows the funding graph to its siblings. One sparrow of a task, planted 20 times per epoch, exposes a farm within a close. Cost to the attacker: every identity must actually read the task, and reading it correctly costs more than the jade it earns. The pearl is the honest answer, and nobody can fake it twice.
